name: workbuddy-connect
description: Reuse the signed-in WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI desktop app session to give ZCode its model catalog, chat, credit balance and diagnostics over MCP tools, and expose the same models through a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that ZCode registers as a normal model provider. Zero configuration: credentials are read from the desktop app's own auth file, refreshed into a plugin-owned copy, and never written back. Protocol ported from corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (MIT).
